title: Pixel Battle
contentNotes: Stylized pixel-art violence, blood effects, finishing moves. No realistic gore, no strong language.
shortDescription: A gritty 8-bit martial-arts fighting game. Fight the CPU, survive the gauntlet, or train.
description: Pixel Battle is a retro 8-bit fighting game built around grounded, realistic martial-arts combat in a gritty arcade style. Pick from a roster of specialized fighters, each with their own style, stats, and unique special moves. Battle the CPU across difficulty tiers, climb a survival gauntlet of hidden opponents, or hone your skills in a free training mode with hitbox visualization. Features hand-drawn pixel-art arenas with animated crowds and ambient wildlife, a regenerating stamina system, combo counters, execute finishers, and synthesized retro sound effects.

controls.note: All controls are rebindable in Settings.

externalServices.name: Base44 backend (optional)
externalServices.purpose: Leaderboard, ranked ELO, and online multiplayer only. Local single-player and training work fully offline with no account.
externalServices.usedBy: Logged-in ranked/multiplayer flows; arcade (CrazyGames) players never trigger login.
